business_problem: Allianz wanted to reduce customer effort and cycle time in claims handling, improve risk assessment and pricing, and move from reactive claims payment toward more predictive and preventive support for policyholders.
solution_summary: Allianz describes an in-production AI claims and risk-management setup embedded across its insurance operations rather than a single standalone platform. In customer interaction, the company uses intelligent chatbots to answer queries, while underwriting uses AI tools to assess and price risks more accurately. The most concrete named implementation is the CE application, developed by Allianz-owned Control Expert, where customers submit photos of damaged cars or parts and an AI solution evaluates the images to produce a loss amount, confirm coverage, and trigger a direct payment offer within minutes. Allianz also uses AI in claims operations to route cases directly to partner repair shops. A second named tool, the Severe Weather SMS tool, combines available customer data with tracked weather patterns to identify at-risk customers and send preventive storm warnings by text message. The source does not name storage platforms or external model providers, but it clearly shows AI ingesting customer images and customer/weather data, processing them for decisioning, and serving outputs through app-based settlement, repair routing, and SMS notifications.

data_flow: Customers submit vehicle-damage photos through the CE application, where AI analyzes the images and returns a loss amount, coverage confirmation, and direct-payment offer; related claims can then be routed to partner repair shops. Separately, Allianz combines available customer data with tracked weather patterns to identify exposed customers and send storm-warning SMS messages before losses occur.
business_outcome: Allianz says these AI tools shorten claims handling to minutes, improve customer satisfaction, support more accurate underwriting and claims routing, help customers avoid weather-related damage, and reduce claims expenses while increasing efficiency and productivity.
